Definition: anointed; usually a consecrated person (as a king, priest, or saint); specifically, the Messiah
BiblicalUsage: 1) anointed, anointed one; 1a) of the Messiah, Messianic prince; 1b) of the king of Israel; 1c) of the high priest of Israel; 1d) of Cyrus; 1e) of the patriarchs as anointed kings
